use_case: Generative AI assistant integrated in the enclave collaboration suite: search, summarize, and draft text from CUI engineering documents (specifications, drawing notes, engineering change requests, work instruction drafts, quality reports)
vendor_or_model: Government-community cloud provider's integrated generative AI assistant (large language model add-on to SYS-02)
data_categories: CUI: controlled technical information, ITAR and EAR technical data in prompts, retrieved files, and outputs
consequential_decision_category: None directly; escalates to Safety/CI if outputs are used for dimensions, tolerances, NC programs, or inspection criteria
human_in_the_loop: A qualified engineer reviews every output before use; engineering release still requires checker sign-off; outputs are never the source for dimensions, tolerances, or NC programs
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012(b)(2)(ii)(D) (FedRAMP Moderate-equivalent cloud); CMMC scoping 32 CFR 170.19(c) (CUI Asset); ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 and 120.54(a)(5); EAR 15 CFR 734.18(a)(5); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Proposed; approved with conditions for an 8-user pilot, not enabled until conditions are met (target 2026-12-31)

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by engineers to summarize or rewrite specification text
vendor_or_model: Various public chatbot services (consumer and free tiers)
data_categories: CUI text pasted by 3 engineers (found in interviews 2026-07-16)
risk_tier: High (CUI and export-controlled data leave company control)
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012 (CUI outside a covered system; possible cyber incident); ITAR 22 CFR 120.56 and 127.12; EAR 15 CFR 764.5
status: Prohibited with CUI (POL-05 4.8); blocked from enclave systems by 2026-10-31 (POAM-006)
